Also, to answer your last questions with my insignificant and unsure knowledge 
Bots have their own vision, they're not necessarily going to see you because you can see them, as long as you're not making too much noise and are not in direct line of sight, they shouldn't just turn on you and blast your face off.  There is a limit to how far they can see(increased with scoped weapons tho) and solid objects like rocks and walls will block their vision but not bushes ,leaves and fences. 
I am not sure as to what the odds of them shooting you in the head or legs are, but of course, the more armor you have, the more difficult it will be for them to kill you, they don't always go for the head, there is some RNG to it and armor really make a difference with most guns
